Abalone - Class in de.my_domain.abalone.model
The Abalone Game implementation.
Abalone(int, int, Player) - Constructor for class de.my_domain.abalone.model.Abalone
The Abalone constructor returns Abalone object and sets its size, difficulty of the machine player as level, and the first player which makes a move.
abaloneToAwt(Color) - Static method in class de.my_domain.abalone.gui.DesignUtil
The abaloneToAwt method is a static method which transforms the three possible Color Objects, which are used in the Abalone Game, into Color, which are used in AWT to represent the color of BallPanels.
addBall(GridPanel, int, int) - Method in class de.my_domain.abalone.gui.BoardPanel
The addBall method is a small helper method, which allows one to add a GridPanel or a BallPanel object to a specified position on the BoardPanel.
award() - Method in class de.my_domain.abalone.gui.GameFrame
The award method should only be called if model.isGameOver() == true.
